t: Building the Living Book: Pipulate's Journey into AI-Augmented Workflow Automation
s: Pipulate's development navigates the integration of LLM coding assistants into workflow automation, balancing predictable scripts with AI's creative but non-deterministic nature. The goal is to achieve 'critical crossover' where abundant code examples guide AI, enabling flexible, modular system design.
sub: Managing LLM predictability in software development
Achieving 'critical crossover' with abundant example code
AI-augmented workflow automation strategies for 'living books'
